entities.description: A servant who empties a packet of strychnine into a basin and stirs it, saying he has cooked Dandy Dick.
entities.name: BLORE

entities.description: A character who takes the basin and goes to the stable, wearing Sir Tristram's coat and cap.
entities.name: THE DEAN

entities.description: A character who enters quietly, smoking and carrying a lighted candle, and later encounters Georgiana.
entities.name: SIR TRISTRAM

entities.description: A character who enters pale and agitated, carrying an umbrella and a lighted candle, and says she has been dreaming.
entities.name: GEORGIANA

entities.description: A horse that Blore says he has cooked.
entities.name: Dandy Dick

entities.description: A substance that Blore empties into a basin.
entities.name: strychnine

entities.description: A small stable where the Dean is going to attend to the animal.
entities.name: the stable

relations.description: Blore empties strychnine into a basin and stirs it, saying he has cooked Dandy Dick.
relations.evidence_quote: I've cooked Dandy Dick! I've cooked Dandy Dick!

relations.description: The Dean goes through the window curtains, presumably to the stable.
relations.evidence_quote: The thunder rolls as he goes through the window curtains.

relations.description: Sir Tristram encounters Georgiana, who shrieks and then recognizes him.
relations.evidence_quote: GEORGIANA. [_Shrieks with fright._] Ah! SIR TRISTRAM. Hush! GEORGIANA. [_Holding out her umbrella._] Stand where you are or I'll fire! [_Recognizing SIR TRISTRAM._] Tris!
